origin.description: Eruption measurements from the Old Faithful geyser in Yellowstone National Park, August 1 to August 15, 1985, as given by Azzalini and Bowman (1990).
origin.details: A data frame with 299 observations and two numeric columns. duration is the eruption length in minutes. waiting is the time until the next eruption. Some night-time durations were recorded only as short, medium, or long, and those were entered as 2, 3, or 4 minutes. This dataset is distributed with MASS under GPL-2 or GPL-3.
origin.value: A data frame with columns duration and waiting.

translation.description: Eruption measurements from the Old Faithful geyser in Yellowstone National Park, August 1 to August 15, 1985, as given by Azzalini and Bowman (1990).
translation.details: A dict of two numeric lists, 299 values each. duration is the eruption length in minutes. waiting is the time until the next eruption. The values are the MASS geyser frame. The rest of MASS is not translated.
translation.value: A dict with keys duration and waiting.
